comments.comment: This step downloads and executes `cargo-hack` from crates.io at CI runtime without a version or checksum pin. Because `cargo install` builds the package before the tests run, a compromised or typosquatted release would get arbitrary code execution in the GitHub Actions runner; pinning the tool version or vendoring it would remove that supply-chain execution path.
